name: Aquatic harness (Large)
body:
Aquatic harness
Source Blood of the Sea pg. 18
Price 20 gp (Large), 10 gp (Medium); Weight 3 lbs. (Large), 2 lbs. (Medium)
Description
This waxed leather harness is designed to withstand submersion and is adjustable to fit dolphins, giant eels, giant seahorsesB4, and other aquatic mounts. Undersea races without access to leather often use harnesses woven from special kelp, which has the same price.
